name: s1tz_benzene
purpose: TASKS 60: S1-TZ phase 1 on s1 — benzene (A_8448043181) at T:def2-tzvp:75,302 with the grid gate at 99/590; its first displaced T Hessian prices the run before naphthalene and acenaphthylene start (PreRegistration_2026-10-14_TZ_Anharmonic_Basis.md; s1 kept for it, the user 14 Oct 'Ja'). MAX_FIRST 7200 s is a safety stop, not a price: G's first benzene Hessian took 112 s and def2-TZVP has 222 basis functions against 6-31G*'s 102, so a third to fourth power gives 1,100-2,500 s; 7200 is about three times the upper end
